accessibility.de: Eingeschränkt; sehr schmale Gassen und unebenes historisches Pflaster

accessibility.ro: Limitată; străzi foarte înguste și pavaj istoric denivelat
accessibility.en: Limited; very narrow alleys and uneven historic paving

photoRules.de: Erlaubt; Stativ in den engen Gassen oft hinderlich

photoRules.en: Allowed; tripods are often a hindrance in the narrow alleys
